detail: cargo test -p session-api transcript_feedback: 18 passed, 0 failed. Covers event-based mine_explicit_ingestion_signals/detects_explicit_ingestion_tool_call_from_events, recover_feedback_entry_from_signal gating on tool_success/rating (recovers_feedback_entry_for_failed_ingestion_call, does_not_duplicate_a_successfully_persisted_ingestion_call, skips_recovery_when_required_arguments_are_missing). Grounded on real transcript analysis: real sessions have zero role:tool turns, so mining reads CopilotHookEvent tool.execution_result events, not transcript turns.
